title: Coinbase Q2 2026 Form 10-Q
summary: The newly filed Q2 2026 Form 10-Q supersedes the Q1 operating baseline. Q2 net revenue was USD 1.154 billion, transaction revenue USD 599 million, subscription and services revenue USD 555 million, stablecoin revenue USD 292 million, net loss USD 359 million, and one counterparty represented 26% of total revenue; the material new evidence requires a full valuation review.
